He looked past the breakers toward the horizon, feeling the vast silence of the sea suddenly shared.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白日的喧嚣，沉浸在深蓝色的微光中。街灯泛着昏黄的光晕，斜斜拉长了环卫工人默默清扫的身影。空旷的高架路上偶尔有一辆货车呼啸而过，车尾灯在潮湿的沥青路面上拖曳出短暂的猩红残影。便利店的白光静静亮着，整座巨兽般的城市正处于深沉的呼吸与初醒的缝隙之间。", "w03": "* Recursion is when a task is solved by breaking it down into smaller, identical versions of itself.\n* A computer program does this by calling its own instructions over and over until the job is small enough to finish.\n* Every recursion needs a clear stopping rule, just like opening a set of Russian nesting dolls until you reach the tiny solid one inside."}
